title: Space
line: Pawns in the center give your pieces room and take it from theirs.

steps.text: Space is the room behind your pawns where your pieces can move. Pawns that move up in the center gain it.
Tap the four squares in the middle of the board: the center.
steps.hint: They are the middle two squares of the middle two files.
steps.after: Pawns on these squares reach far into the other half.

steps.text: Push your pawn on e4 one square. It chases the knight and takes space.
steps.after: The knight jumps to the center.

steps.text: Push the pawn in front of your queen two squares.

also.c2c4: That chases the knight at once, and it is as strong. This lesson pushes the center pawn first.

steps.after: Black hits your pawn on e5.

steps.text: Push the pawn on c2 two squares and chase the knight again.
steps.after: The knight goes back. Black's pieces have little room.

steps.text: Guard your pawn on e5 with one more pawn: push the pawn on f2 two squares.
steps.after: Four white pawns hold the middle. They are also targets: in this opening Black lets them come forward, then attacks them.

summary: Pawns in the center give your pieces room and take it from your opponent's pieces.
